draft.summary: No published NFL.com prospect grade was collected for him. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 83 receiving yards in 2021, 18th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns (practice squad). 33 career games and 4 starts over 3 completed seasons. His 2025 season (1 AV) was his best yet. Weak spots: receiving yards 72 (21st percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 72 receiving yards against a median of 179, below the norm.
